title: fix: use media URLs for music references
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Accepts `media.pollinations.ai` URLs as `reference_audio` and downloads them before provider dispatch.
- Keeps the ElevenLabs `/v1/music/upload` call and `song_id` conditioning internal to music generation.
- Meters newly uploaded reference duration at $0.0025/second in addition to generated output; reused `song_id` references do not incur ingestion again.
- Migrates Stable Audio references to the same media URL contract and rejects arbitrary reference hosts.
- Removes the public `POST /v1/audio/music/upload` route.

Evidence:
- ElevenLabs direct probes: 30 seconds uploaded cost $0.075; a 10-second upload with `extract_composition_plan=music_v2` cost $0.025 and returned exact duration.
- Full Gen route suite: 58/58; verifies media URL fetch → ElevenLabs upload → generation and billed prompt-audio duration.
- ElevenMusic unit tests: 3/3; OpenAPI: 2/2; effective-price snapshot: 1/1.
- Gen and Enter typechecks pass; Biome clean.

Draft gate:
- Run one live staging media upload → ElevenMusic generation E2E before readiness.

Fixes #13316

gist.headline: Music references found their path
gist.blurb: Music references can now travel through the hive on media.pollinations.ai URLs instead of wandering in from arbitrary hosts. Upload once, make songs, and let reused references rest between gigs.
gist.summary: Music generation now accepts and securely fetches media.pollinations.ai URLs as reference_audio for ElevenMusic and Stable Audio, uploads new references internally for conditioning, and meters new reference ingestion at $0.0025 per second while reused song_id references avoid another ingestion charge.
gist.impact: Developers can use one media URL reference contract across supported music providers, with reference-audio duration billed only when a new upload is needed and existing song_id references reused without being ingested again.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy music workshop where a media URL arrives as a little glowing cassette or sound-wave parcel and is fed into a retro music generator, producing notes and waveform flowers. Polli should actively guide the reference into the machine, wearing music-studio headphones; a small CRT robot can monitor the clean media URL route while code-plants and flowers reinforce the safe, unified pipeline.
